Definition: from G5613 and G1487; as if:--about, as (it had been, it were), like (as).
BiblicalUsage: hōseí is the word for as if, about, like. In Matthew 3:16, the text says "and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hōseí, I take at face value: as if, about, like.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
RelatedEvents: The Baptism of Jesus; The Healing of the Demon-Possessed Boy
